identity.title: [v0.91.7][csdlc-v2][closeout] Add typed terminal design repair before receipt reconciliation

values.goal: Repair and reapprove retained design artifacts for closed-out issues through a typed atomic route.
values.required_outcome: A closed-out issue can receive an explicitly authorized, hash-bound design/diagram repair whose receipt, cards, projections, and audit record update atomically and can be materialized by reconcile-terminal.
authority_boundary: Rust v2 closeout/store code is the sole mutation authority
Repair authority must be explicit and hash-bound
Terminal receipts remain immutable except through the typed repair transaction
